body:
Founder real-time: 'we can go full wasm with parena we need to dog food that anyways.' Checked directly: llc already registers wasm32/wasm64 as real targets, same LLVM install already proven against AVR. New make wasm-smoke: compiles examples/wasm/clamp.prn (real F64 scalar clamp) through parena build -> llc -mtriple=wasm32-unknown-unknown -> wasm-ld -> a real .wasm module, then actually executes it in Node.js and asserts correct F64 results. Verified clean from a fresh build. Retargeted CAPTCHA_FPS_PHYSICS_DOGFOOD_NORTHSTAR.md's own Phase 1 at emit_llvm.c instead of emit_ts.c -- one compiler investment reaches native AND wasm together. PARENA commit c0b818d, SHANKPIT commit 0606dac, both pushed.

⚓ ☃
title: Real, live WebAssembly output proven -- zero new compiler code needed
